about_the_game:
"My Company" is a deep business simulation game where you start from scratch and build your own company in a virtual world. Experience the full journey from entrepreneurship, hiring staff, developing products, marketing, to expanding your business empire.

  • Story: You play as an entrepreneur aiming to build a leading company in a competitive market.

  • Character Progression: As you make decisions and manage your company, you unlock new features and face greater challenges.

  • Goals: Achieve profitability, expand your market share, outcompete rivals, and become an industry giant.

  • Challenges & Mechanics: Face economic fluctuations, manage employees, adapt to changing customer demands, and test your business acumen.

  • Game Mechanics: Includes financial management, product development, marketing, team building, and more.

  • Playtime: Each playthrough lasts about 10-20 hours, with high replayability and unique experiences every time.

  • Genre: Strategy, Simulation, Management.

Whether you're new to business or a fan of simulation games, you'll find unique management fun in this game!
